annotation.summary_en: Two corrupt politicians debate raising prices on citizens by 30%, only to find a passerby who enthusiastically supports a 200% price hike because of his profession.
annotation.summary_detailed_en: The sketch takes place in an autumn park where two well-dressed politicians, Avanes and Sanasar, are discussing recent activities in the National Assembly. Sanasar describes a chaotic scene where a fellow deputy performed athletic stunts, jumping between desks to press buttons for absent colleagues, successfully passing a bill with 250 votes despite only 10 members being present. The conversation shifts to a proposal to increase all prices in Armenia by 30%. While Sanasar initially feigns concern for the poor, Avanes insists that the people live better than them. To settle the debate, they stop a passerby in a tan trench coat to ask how he would survive such an increase. The man remains indifferent to a 10%, 20%, and even 30% hike. When the politicians jokingly ask how he would handle a 200% price increase—where meat would jump to 8000 drams—the man gleefully replies that he would be able to buy a new car and a brand-name house in a month. The punchline reveals his motivation: he works at a morgue, meaning he profits from the increased death rate caused by poverty.
